notes.title: Ortheo V2.1.0 Release
notes.notes:
Hey All,

I just finished the final update for Ortheo. Expect news on Ortheo: Voyage soon!

notes.title: Ortheo V2.0.0 Release + Patch Notes + Port Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey All,

This is without a doubt the biggest update yet. We have completely overhauled the visuals of the game and made a new boss entirely from scratch. There are also some smaller changes such as a new intro cutscene, a level select, and more. While there are too many changes for us to go over, just know that this new update fixes a hefty majority of issues people have had with the game and adds mountains of polish. Of course, as is the case with game development, we are still quite not done yet.

We have a Special Announcement:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39781215/0bdb11e859f611a66f101c106ad9c40f5cf38953.png[/img]

Ortheo is coming to Xbox and Mac devices THIS MONTH! The Xbox version will also receive an Xbox exclusive hat! Hope you all enjoy the update!

- Dallen Larson

notes.title: Ortheo V1.2.3 Release + Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey All,

The camera sucked before. NOT ANYMORE! ENJOY!

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
- Added Option to Skip Cutscene
- Added V-Sync Options
- Completely Redid the Camera Input.
- Added Extra Gears in Worlds 1 & 3.
- Fixed some small universal bugs.
- Changed Character Controllers Speed + Momentum Values.


Best played with a controller!

- Dallen Larson

notes.title: Ortheo V1.2.0 Release + Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey All,

Thanks for the feedback and reviews! A lot of feedback has been given on the Indie Rumble Official Discord has well. Here is the newest update.

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
- Added 4 Achievements.
- Added "More Options" In Main Menu To Keep Things Organized.
- Added New Intro Cutscene.
- Added Resolution Settings in Options.
- Added Transition Animations for Between Levels
- Change Library Art.
- Changed Upcoming Features.
- Customization Menu's Block Now Disabled When Customizing.
- Camera Can Now Look Higher.
- Fixed Universal Camera Jank.
- Fixed Pause Button Not Working On Worlds After 1 Issue.

Isn't that a lot!? This update adds TONS of polish. In the menu, if you click Upcoming Features, you can see a ton of stuff I plan on adding within the week. Have a great week everyone! Thank you for playing Ortheo!

- Dallen Larson

notes.title: Ortheo V1.1.0 Release + Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey All,

Ortheo launched yesterday after over 9 years of sitting in my brain. It had a few bugs so this update fixed most of em'! We also added Character Customization.

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
- Fixed Level 2's Paublo's not moving/floating.
- Changed Level 3's Layout slightly to make it easier.
- Fixed Level 3's Exit not working.
- Made Gears and Coins closer to ground to collect easier.
- Extended Outro Cutscene.
- Added Character Customization.
- Fixed Universal Camera Jank.
- A Certain Frog Appears On Grassy Greens now.

Hope you are all enjoying the game so far! There is still work to be done! See you within a week for V1.2.0 which will fix more bugs, and add some of the features shown in Upcoming Features!

- Dallen Larson
